content.title: ITT Reports Net Margin Decline, Challenging Bullish Narratives on Earnings Quality
content.summary: ITT (NYSE:ITT) reported a net profit margin of 12.6%, down from 13.7% a year earlier, signaling some margin compression. Over the last five years, earnings per share grew at an impressive 26% annual pace, but the most recent year saw a decline in earnings, tempering the company’s otherwise strong multiyear track record. Revenue and earnings are projected to rise at 6.4% and 11.6% per year, respectively, both slower than the broader US market, while shares trade at $187.06, carrying a premium...
